objectDescription:
This dataset contains the needed fields so that you can get the UDF Descriptions for Picklist and Text fields.
You will Join this Dataset to your reports that need this information
vaultSummary: This dataset contains the needed fields so that you can get the UDF Descriptions for Picklist fields.

fields.label: UDF Key
fields.description:
The UDF Identifier
<UDF Identifier>*<UDF Type>*<UDF Position>

fields.label: Udf Identifier
fields.description:
What data the UDFs are associated with.  Here are the options:
AR - Client AR UDFs - https://naviga-informer-docs.netlify.app/docs/informer/informer-mappings-udf-fields#client-ar-udf
CRM - CRM UDFs - https://naviga-informer-docs.netlify.app/docs/informer/informer-mappings-udf-fields#crm-udf
INET - Campaign UDFs - https://naviga-informer-docs.netlify.app/docs/informer/informer-mappings-udf-fields#campaign-udf
INET.LINE - Order Line UDFs - https://naviga-informer-docs.netlify.app/docs/informer/informer-mappings-udf-fields#order-line-udf
OPP - Opportunity UDFs - https://naviga-informer-docs.netlify.app/docs/informer/informer-mappings-udf-fields#opportunity-udf

fields.label: Udf Type
fields.description:
We are only concerned with PICKLIST and TEXT for this dataset. The full list is:
PICKLIST 
DATE
NUMERIC
TEXT

fields.label: Udf Position
fields.description: This will be the position of the UDF.  For example: UDF_PICKLIST_1 where 1 is the position.

fields.label: UDF Code
fields.description: A code identifying the picklist or text value

fields.label: UDF Code Desc
fields.description: The description of the UDF Code.  This is what people will want to see.
